line.name: RoMa Craft Intemperance EC XVIII
line.description: Not on the site - the site only has 'RoMa Craft Intemperance BA XXI' as its own entry, not this sibling sub-blend. Part of RoMa Craft's Prohibition-era-themed Intemperance concept (launched 2012); 'EC' = Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper, 'XVIII' references the 18th Amendment (which enacted Prohibition).
